hadith:
Invocations - Narrated Abu Musa:

The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "The example of the one who celebrates the Praises of his Lord (Allah) in comparison to the one who does not celebrate the Praises of his Lord, is that of a living creature compared to a dead one."
message: The Quran is a reminder guiding those who choose the Straight Way. Keep Allah in your remembrance, and reflect that He is the Reckoner—no deed is overlooked.
name:
Al Haseeb - الْحسِيبُ - The Reckoner

Al Haseeb expresses taking account and being sufficient. Quran 4:6 and 4:86 connect the name with reckoning, while 33:39 describes Allah as sufficient as a reckoner. No deed is lost or overlooked in His accounting.
verse:
At-Takwir - The Overthrowing - 81:26-28

So what ˹other˺ path would you take?

Surely this ˹Quran˺ is only a reminder to the whole world—

to whoever of you wills to take the Straight Way.
